geography: state (48 states; the District of Columbia is read but left out, as in Miller's panel)
source: Vital Statistics of the United States, 1937 and 1938, Part I (US Bureau of the Census): Table 19, deaths from selected causes by race, sex and population groups, each state (White + Other); Table 18 for smallpox (List No. 6) and List Nos. 196-198
terms: US federal publication; no terms stated on the CDC/NCHS page.
method: Read by OCR (tesseract) from the CDC/NCHS scans, cell by cell, then settled with the table's own sums: a state total is kept when at least two of four derivations agree (the printed total; male + female; the three population groups; the groups' male + female), and a state is kept only when its White and Other rows both add across (total deaths = the sum of the cause columns). Cells the sums could not settle were read by eye on the page (contact sheets of every unsettled row, and of every column whose states did not add up to the United States line). Every column used adds up across the 48 states and DC to the printed United States line, for White and for Other, in both years. Table 18 lines were read by eye.
